bottleneck: Attention selects what the brain processes, but its mechanism — how a spotlight of processing moves across cortex, what computes its target, and how it alters neural responses — has no settled model. Competing theories (gain modulation, communication-through-coherence, normalization, predictive routing) each explain some data and fail on others. Without a mechanism, attention disorders like ADHD are treated with stimulants whose circuit effects are poorly characterized, and AI attention mechanisms borrow the name while implementing something unrelated. The gate of all perception and learning is a black box.
current_state: The field agrees attention involves frontoparietal control biasing sensory cortex, but the computational mechanism remains contested with no decisive experiment designed.

title: Attention's computational mechanism unsettled
why_it_blocks: Attention gates all learning, perception, and memory encoding. A mechanistic account would transform ADHD treatment, education, and AI architecture — instead the most important filter in cognition is the least understood.
